name: Premium Snacks Nordic AB (publ)
summary: Premium Snacks Nordic AB (publ) is a company focused on the creation, production, and sale of various snack foods throughout the Nordic region, marketed primarily under its Exotic Snacks and Gårdschips labels. Their diverse selection ranges from natural and spicy nut mixes, exquisite chocolate dragees, and licorice, to unique Asian rice snacks, exotic dried fruits, and traditional potato chips. In addition to its domestic market presence, the company also distributes its products internationally. The enterprise, which commenced operations in 2007, was previously known as Rootfruit Scandinavia AB (publ) before rebranding to Premium Snacks Nordic AB (publ) in October 2020. Its headquarters are situated in Laholm, Sweden.
